summary: Monolith's first-person survival-horror series; play Criminal Origins on PC if preserved, and choose the Xbox 360 version of Bloodshot because the sequel never received a PC port and PS3 audio issues were publicly reported.

entries.title: Condemned: Criminal Origins

emulation.emulator: Native PC; Xbox 360 hardware/backward compatibility fallback
emulation.notes: Use PC if available; otherwise use an owned Xbox 360 copy/route.

primary.why: Criminal Origins shipped on Xbox 360 and Windows; the PC version has the highest fidelity ceiling, but public reporting in 2025 notes it was delisted from Steam and Xbox storefronts.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version if already owned or available through a legitimate preserved key/disc route; use Xbox 360 hardware/backward-compatible ownership only if the PC version is unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster exists; current issue is availability, not a content-cut remaster.

entries.title: Condemned 2: Bloodshot

emulation.notes: Original Xbox 360 hardware is the reliable preservation route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Xbox 360 output or accurate Xbox 360 emulation

primary.why: Bloodshot shipped on Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 with no PC port documented; contemporary reporting noted PS3 audio problems, so Xbox 360 is the cleaner primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware, or use a compatible preservation/emulation setup only if it accurately runs the Xbox 360 release.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC release or remaster is known to exist.
